# MediaPipe Face Landmarker

The MediaPipe Tasks Vision browser runtime and WASM files are the unmodified
[@mediapipe/tasks-vision 0.10.32](https://registry.npmjs.org/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/-/tasks-vision-0.10.32.tgz)
distribution, copyright The MediaPipe Authors, under the
[Apache License 2.0](LICENSE.txt). See the [upstream source](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe).

The Face Landmarker task is Google's official
[float16, version 1 model](https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/face_landmarker/face_landmarker/float16/1/face_landmarker.task).
The MediaPipe project confirms the [bundled models use Apache 2.0](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe-samples/issues/407).

- Browser module SHA-256: `de83c48ff329717a27aeb528d5ef5f47f077c628a5302dc483aca5b513e7464b`
- Model SHA-256: `64184e229b263107bc2b804c6625db1341ff2bb731874b0bcc2fe6544e0bc9ff`

The lab loads these files from the site's own origin after explicit consent.
